task.ques: Search on ESPN for how many teams have 'Golden' in their name and how many of them are in the NHL.

claude.final_answer:
FINAL: ESPN’s Teams search for “Golden” lists 25 teams, counting each sport’s team separately. Of these, 1 is in the NHL: the Vegas Golden Knights.
Evidence: ESPN’s Teams results show 25 cards in a 5-by-5 grid; only Vegas Golden Knights is labeled “NHL.” Search checked October 28, 2026: https://www.espn.com/search/_/type/teams/q/golden . Screenshot: final.png.
